nodes.text: A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays.
Toast bread, top with mashed avocado, a fried egg, salt, pepper, and chili flakes. Feel free to substitute with ingredients you have on hand.

Mix shredded cooked chicken with BBQ sauce. Place on tortillas with cheese, fold and cook until crispy. Try adding a pinch of your favorite spices for extra flavor.
An ideal recipe for experimenting with different flavors and ingredients.
Pulse cauliflower in a food processor until it resembles rice. Sauté with vegetables, soy sauce, and add scrambled eggs. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.
